Description:
❄️✨ Abrah’s Winter Desserts ✨❄️

Abrah’s Winter Desserts is a small collection of cute handmade winter themed food items created to make the winter season in Stardew Valley feel sweeter magical and full of charm.

❄️ How to InstallDownload the mod
Open your Stardew Valley Mods folder
Place the folder called Abrah’s Winter Desserts inside your Mods folder
Do not mix the contents of the folders with each other
Launch the game through SMAPI
Your desserts will appear automatically in your kitchen once you download the mods
